notes.notes:
Hey Survivors!

But hey — that’s how we make MIMESIS a better game, right?



So, what do you want from MIMESIS?

notes.title: [HOTFIX – June 11th ]
notes.notes:
Greetings, Survivors.

 

We’d like to share details regarding recent improvements and fixes made to enhance your gaming experience.


1. Improved a rare issue that occurred during tram repairs.2. Improved a character movement and monster animations under unstable 3. network conditions.4. Improved an issue where some users were unable to join the game properly.5. Fixed an issue where the microphone appeared as “NONE” and could not be selected in the settings menu.6. Improved a rare issue where item purchases in the shop were not processed correctly.7. Improved various functions related to network synchronization.
 

Improved multiple issues that were causing inconvenience while using MIMESIS.


Users with different versions of the game will not be able to play together.please make sure to get the update and restart the game.
If the update does not proceed automatically or the button remains inactive, please exit the Steam client completely and reconnect to initiate the update.



Thank you.
